resources.string: Watch not connected – changes are sent as soon as it is.
Live departures on the start page
The next departures of the nearest stop right on the watch\'s start page. Off: the button “Departures nearby” as before.
Rows that slide in, rolling minutes, the moving ring. Off for an older or slower watch: everything is simply there.
Open the live trip on the watch
When you start a trip here, the watch opens its live trip by itself. Off: it shows the trip in the ongoing activity only.
How the map pictures on the watch look. Automatic is dark on the watch\'s black screen.
The tile “To a favourite” shows the next connection to this place.
The watch vibrates before you get off. The same setting as on the phone.
The watch searches with the change time of the phone: %1$s. Change it under “Connections & changes”.
